product_overview: PLYAZ League Manager is a multi-organization sports championship management platform for organizing leagues, competitions, teams, and live match operations. It supports role-based workflows for organizers, referees, coaches, players, and public users with public discovery, registration, live scoring, and billing capabilities.
core_goals: Enable organizers to create and manage multiple organizations and competitions with minimal manual effort
Support role-based access control for members, invites, applications, and protected league operations
Provide tools for team, player, venue, category, and competition management within an organization
Automate competition operations such as draws, standings, and fixture generation
Support live match lifecycle management and event scoring for referees
Allow public users to discover teams/competitions and subscribe to updates
Integrate billing flows for checkout and webhook-based payment processing

features.name: Authentication & Session
features.description: Provides cookie-based authenticated sessions for protected profile and league operations. Requests without a valid session cookie are denied.
user_flows: PATCH /api/profile with a valid authenticated session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated Profile -> User remains authenticated for subsequent protected calls
PATCH /api/profile without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> No profile update is applied

features.name: Discovery (public)
features.description: Lets public visitors browse recruiting teams and competitions without signing in.
user_flows: GET /api/discover/teams -> Receive 200 with Team[] of teams open for player recruitment
GET /api/discover/competitions -> Receive 200 with Competition[] of competitions open for referee recruitment
GET /api/discover/teams when no public teams are available -> Receive 200 with an empty Team[] list

features.name: Newsletter (public)
features.description: Allows any visitor to subscribe an email address to the newsletter.
user_flows: POST /api/newsletter with a valid email body -> Receive 200 Ok -> Email is added to the newsletter list
POST /api/newsletter with an invalid or missing email body -> Receive 400 Validation error -> Subscription is rejected

features.name: Applications (Recruitment)
features.description: Supports authenticated users applying to teams or competitions and allows organizers to review and decide on submissions.
user_flows: POST /api/applications with applicant_role, target_id, target_type, and message using a valid session -> Receive 200 with created Application -> Application is available for organizer review
GET /api/applications with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Application[] relevant to the authenticated user
PATCH /api/applications/{id} with a valid session cookie and review action -> Receive 200 with updated Application status
POST /api/applications without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Application is not created
POST /api/applications with invalid body fields -> Receive 400 Validation error -> Application is not created

features.name: League Organizations & Members
features.description: Enables authenticated users to list and create organizations and inspect organization membership.
user_flows: GET /api/league/organizations with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Organization[] belonging to the user
POST /api/league/organizations with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with created Organization -> New organization becomes available to the user
GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/users with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Member[] for the organization
GET /api/league/organizations without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> No organization data is returned

features.name: League Entities (Teams, Players, Venues, Categories)
features.description: Provides organization-scoped CRUD-style listing and creation for core league entities such as teams, players, venues, and categories.
user_flows: GET /api/league/teams with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Team[] in the user's organization
POST /api/league/teams with a valid session cookie and valid payload -> Receive 200 with created Team -> Team is added to the organization
GET /api/league/players with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Player[] in the user's organization
GET /api/league/venues with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Venue[]
GET /api/league/categories with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Category[]
POST /api/league/teams without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Team is not created
POST /api/league/teams with an invalid body or rate limit exceeded -> Receive 400 Validation error or 429 Rate limited -> Team creation is rejected

features.name: Competitions
features.description: Allows organizations to create competitions, inspect standings, and run draw operations for fixture generation.
user_flows: POST /api/league/competitions with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with created Competition -> Competition is added to the organization
GET /api/league/competitions with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Competition[] in the organization
GET /api/league/competitions/{id}/standings with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Standing[] for the competition
POST /api/league/competitions/{id}/draw with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with DrawResult -> Fixtures are generated from the draw
GET /api/league/competitions without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> No competition data is returned

features.name: Matches & Live Scoring
features.description: Supports listing matches and updating match state with live event recording during match play.
user_flows: GET /api/league/matches with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Match[] in the organization
POST /api/league/matches/{id}/start with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated Match status set to live
POST /api/league/matches/{id}/events with a valid session cookie and event payload -> Receive 200 with MatchEvent -> Event is recorded against the match
POST /api/league/matches/{id}/end with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated Match status set to completed
POST /api/league/matches/{id}/start without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Match state is not changed

features.name: Invites
features.description: Lets organizations verify invite tokens before signup and allows authenticated users to accept invites.
user_flows: POST /api/league/invites/verify with a valid token -> Receive 200 with InviteInfo -> Prospective member can view invite details before signup
POST /api/league/invites/accept with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 Ok -> Invite is accepted and membership is established
GET /api/league/invites with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with Invite[] for the organization
POST /api/league/invites/verify with an invalid or expired token -> Receive 400 Invalid or expired token -> Invite details are not returned
POST /api/league/invites/accept without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Invite is not accepted

features.name: Stripe Billing
features.description: Handles authenticated checkout session creation and Stripe webhook processing for billing-related workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/stripe/checkout with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with CheckoutSession -> User is redirected to Stripe checkout
POST /api/stripe/webhook with a valid Stripe signature -> Receive 200 Ok -> Billing event is accepted and processed
POST /api/stripe/webhook with an invalid signature -> Receive 400 Invalid signature -> Billing event is rejected
POST /api/stripe/checkout without a valid session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Checkout session is not created

features.name: Authentication & Session
features.description: Supabase cookie-based sessions. Protected routes call getUserOrgId(); with no valid session cookie they return 401. There is no bearer-token path on the server client, so unauthenticated HTTP calls to protected endpoints must return 401/403.

known_limitations.issue: Server Supabase client is cookie-session only; there is no bearer-token auth path
known_limitations.impact: Pure HTTP backend tests cannot easily authenticate to protected routes; they can validate 401 behavior and public endpoints, but full protected-route testing needs a browser-acquired session cookie.

known_limitations.impact: Console error "Unexpected token '<' ... is not valid JSON"; Leagues/Teams stat cards show 0 despite data existing.
